description.description: What the template is for, shown to whoever uses it.

name.description: What `debug: console` calls a card built from this template; it can use the card's variables.

category.description: Groups templates in the picker - "Rooms", "Badges" - for dashboards with many.

publish.description: Lists the template as a card of its own in Home Assistant's add-card dialog; a string names the entry.

deprecated.description: Says the template is on its way out - `true`, or a message saying what to use instead. Not inherited.

examples.description: Sets of variables the template is shown working with: checked by the health panel, offered by the editors.

on_error.description: What a card using this template shows instead of an error, unless the card says otherwise.

checks.description: What counts as a problem with the values a card gives it (#389): each a `condition`, a `message`, a `level` - info, warn or error - and for an error whether to go on building.

alert.description: A config of the template's kind shown instead of the card while a warn or error check has failed.

strict.description: What a card using this template does about errors and warnings, unless the card says otherwise (#390).

suggest_for.description: Which entities Home Assistant's add-card dialog offers this template for.

editor_hide.description: Parts of the card editor this template has no use for - `repeat`, `extras`, `fit`, `advanced` or an Advanced field.

rebuild_on.description: Entities a card using this template rebuilds on, as well as the card's own - and the only ones `|state` and `|attr:` can read. Placeholders are filled from the variables: `'[[camera]]'` (#411).

rebuild_on_watch.description: What a rebuild_on entity's change is compared on, for cards using this template that do not say (#411).

author.description: Who wrote it: a name, or `name`/`github`/`email`/`url`. For sharing; not inherited.

license.description: The licence it is shared under. Not inherited.

help.description: A page or post explaining it. Not inherited.

homepage.description: Where it lives, and where newer versions are. Not inherited.

readme.description: Markdown shown before it is installed. Not inherited.

related.description: Templates that belong with this one without it calling them; they travel with it. Not inherited.

requires.description: Integrations, entities, custom cards and versions it needs, checked before installing.

setup.description: Variables to ask for when it is installed, written into its defaults.

extends.description: The template this one builds on: its content underneath, this one's last word on top. A list builds on several, left to right, each later one over the ones before.

variables.description: The variables the template takes, described so its editor can offer real controls.

anyOf.description: The variables the template takes, described so its editor can offer real controls.
The same declarations keyed by name: a scalar or list is the default, a mapping is the whole declaration, null is a bare name.

language.description: The template's texts in each language (#392), keyed by language code - `en`, `de`, `pt-BR` - each a mapping of texts of any depth. `[[$key.path]]` anywhere in the template is that text in Home Assistant's language, falling back to the language without its region, then `en`, then the first one given. `extends:` merges them key by key.

defaults.description: `default:` spelled plural, read the same - the two are merged, `default:` winning a name both set.

let.description: Values the template computes for itself from the others - `room_slug: '[[room|slug]]'` written once instead of the chain repeated everywhere. Template internals: an instance cannot override one.

item.description: A piece of config rather than a card - one entry of a camera card's `cameras:`, say - filled in where a placeholder asks for it: `[[name|with:...]]` once, `[[name|repeat:...]]` once per item. Takes `default:`, `let:` and `variables:` like any template.

function.description: A template used as a step (#307): `[[room|name]]`, `[[room|name:a,b]]`. What the step gives - a placeholder text or a plain value - with the value it is applied to as `[[value]]`. It sees nothing of the card's variables: only the value, its arguments, and its own `default:` and `let:`.

parameters.description: For a function template: the names its unnamed arguments take, in order.

for_each.description: For an item template: what a bare `[[name|repeat]]` repeats over - a list, or a placeholder that fills to one.

for_each_from.description: For an item template: the registry source a bare `[[name|repeat]]` repeats over.

group.description: Cards that take their places in the section one by one, as if each were written there.

dashboard.description: A whole dashboard, for a dashboard strategy's `page:` to build. Not a card.

grid_options.description: How much of a sections grid a card built from this template asks for.

visibility.description: Conditions on the variables that decide whether a copy is built at all - `variable:` with `exists`, `equals`, `not_equals`, `in`, `not_in` or `matches`. Every one must hold.

version.description: Which version of itself the template is, for the health panel and the shared store. Not enforced.

changes.description: What changed in each version, keyed by version - the health panel reads a variable's story from these.

condition.description: A show_if condition - `name`, `!name`, `name=text`, `name!=text` - text with placeholders, or true or false.

fail_on.description: What the condition comes out as when the check fails. True unless it says otherwise.

message.description: What is said when it fails, with placeholders; a generic sentence when there is none.

continue_rendering.description: An error with `false` fails the build, so `on_error:` takes over.

StrictConfig.description: The level-by-level form of `strict:`. `error` and `warn` are taken too, the words #390 asked with.

RebuildOnValue.description: A rebuild_on value: one entity or many, each an id or `{entity, watch}`.

entity.description: The entity id, or a placeholder that fills to one.

watch.description: `read`, `all`, or a list of `state`, `last_changed`, `last_updated` and attribute names.

RebuildOnEntity.description: One rebuild_on entity that says which parts of its state count as a change (#411).

RebuildWatch.description: What counts as a change of a rebuild_on entity (#411): `all`, `read`, or the parts named.

selector.description: A Home Assistant selector, in the same shape ha-form takes.

defaults.description: `default:` spelled plural, read the same; `default:` wins when both are written.

required.description: Whether the template is unusable without it. Warns; it never blocks a save.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match. Warns; it never blocks a save.

allowed.description: The values this variable can take. Warns; it never blocks a save.

group.description: Declarations sharing a group fold into one collapsible section of the editor.

type.description: What kind of value it takes - see VARIABLE_TYPES - which picks its editor control.

domain.description: `type: entity`: the domains it may come from, one or a list.

device_class.description: `type: entity`: the device class it must have, one or a list.

min.description: `type: number`: the range, the step between values, and the unit shown beside it.

multiline.description: `type: text`: a box with room for more than one line.

show_if.description: Shows the field in the card editor only while one of these holds - `if:` conditions, written without the `if:`.

hide_if.description: Hides the field in the card editor while any of these holds.

options_from.description: A dropdown of what this source finds - the same source `for_each_from:` takes (#404).

option_value.description: With `options_from:`, what each option sets the variable to, filled in per thing found.

option_label.description: With `options_from:`, what each option shows; the value when unset.

required.description: Whether the template is unusable without it. Warns; it never blocks a save.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match. Warns; it never blocks a save.

domain.description: `type: entity`: the domains it may come from, one or a list.

device_class.description: `type: entity`: the device class it must have, one or a list.

min.description: `type: number`: the range, the step between values, and the unit shown beside it.

hide_if.description: Hides the field in the card editor while any of these holds.

options_from.description: A dropdown of what this source finds - the same source `for_each_from:` takes (#404).

option_value.description: With `options_from:`, what each option sets the variable to, filled in per thing found.

option_label.description: With `options_from:`, what each option shows; the value when unset.

VariableDeclarationByName.description: A declaration under a mapping-form `variables:`, named by its key.

VisibilityCondition.description: One condition: a `variable` and exists, equals, not_equals, in, not_in, matches.

text_with_placeholders.patternErrorMessage: A [[placeholder]] here is not well formed. Check that the brackets come in pairs and that a step with a value is written name:value, as in if:name or default:x. Misspelt step names are not checked here: the card editor and lint name them.
text_with_placeholders.description: Text, with any number of [[placeholders]]. Each placeholder is a variable name, then any steps - built-in ones, or a template used as a step - then an optional ?.

config_with_placeholders.description: Card, row, badge or element configuration. Strings in it may hold [[placeholders]].
